resources.string: Want a quick tour? See how to use your remote, the menu and where everything is.
You can take the tour any time from Settings → Help.
Take the tour again, or any part of it in more detail
Take the whole tour, or learn more about one part of WeaselPlex.
Press and hold OK on a poster for more options.
plays the movie or episode you\'re on.
Press ◀ to open the menu. Move ▲ ▼ to look around, then press ▶ to come back here.
(OK would open that page; BACK leaves the tour.)
That\'s the menu. It\'s on the left of most pages, and BACK on Home opens it too.
You: switch profiles or add someone.
Now Playing: the music that\'s playing now.
Search: find a title by typing or with your voice.
Home: rows to watch from, starting with what you\'re watching.
%1$s: ask for something that isn\'t in WeaselPlex yet, and follow your requests.
%1$s: menu items you\'ve moved out of the way.
At the top: You — switch profiles or add someone.
You can take the tour any time from Settings → Help.
The top shows details for whatever you\'re on.
Rows include Next Up & Continue watching, Streaming Services and Recently Added.
Rows include Next up & continue watching and Watch again.
A full row ends with an arrow that opens the whole list.
Hold OK on a poster for options like Add to Watchlist. ⏯ plays a movie or episode straight away.
In Streaming Services, press OK on a service to see what WeaselPlex has from it, with All, Movies and Shows.
Choose rows and pictures in Settings → Customize home page.
BACK on Home opens the menu. Press BACK again to leave WeaselPlex.
Play, or Resume where you left off. Restart starts over.
Add to Watchlist saves it for later.
More has audio, subtitles and versions.
Shows list their seasons; pick one to see its episodes.
Play, or Keep watching where you left off. Start over starts again.
Play trailer, when the title has one.
Mark as watched, so it leaves Next Up.
Further down: People, More like this and, on shows, Cast & Crew.
Some pages are for titles WeaselPlex doesn\'t have yet. Their first button is Request. It then shows Pending, and Go To once it\'s ready to watch.
Press OK or ▼ to show the controls.
Press ▼ to show the controls. OK pauses and plays, because Pause with one click is on.
jump back %1$d s or ahead %2$d s.
In the controls, CC is subtitles and the speaker is audio.
BACK hides the controls; press it again to stop.
You\'ve chosen another player app, so its own controls apply.
Skip Intro appears by itself when a show has one. Press OK to skip.
At the end, Next Up… counts down to the next episode. BACK stops the countdown.
The ⚙ button has Playback Speed and Video Scale.
Change how subtitles look in Settings → Subtitle style.
Search by typing, or with the mic button on the Search page.
Can\'t find something? Request it, then follow it in %1$s → %2$s.
Search has a Library tab and a %1$s tab, for titles WeaselPlex doesn\'t have yet.
Request a whole show, or pick the seasons you want and press Submit.
The title\'s page shows Pending until it\'s added, then Go To.
Settings: customise Home and the menu, add a PIN to your profile, change subtitle style.
Want more detail on any part? Settings → Help.
Profile protection adds a PIN to your profile, or asks you to sign in every time.
Switch profile or add someone from You at the top of the menu. New people sign in with the same QR code.
WeaselPlex tells you when there\'s an update. You can also look in Settings → Check for updates.
This tour is always in Settings → Help → WeaselPlex tour.
Choose which items the menu shows in Settings → Customize Navigation Drawer Items. The others go under More.
%1$s groups films that belong together, like a series of movies.
%1$s holds your own lists. Hold OK on a title and choose Add to playlist.
Hold OK on a title and choose Add to playlist to start your own list. Playlists then appears in the menu.
%1$s in the menu has the guide. Pick a show to watch it live.
